tasks.label: table_image
tasks.command: pg_dump -U USERNAME -d DATABASE -h HOST -p PORT  -t TABLE -F p --clean > ${workspaceFolder}/db_backup/${input:sql-dump-file-name}.sql

tasks.label: clear_table
tasks.command: psql -U USERNAME -d DATABASE -h HOST -p PORT -c "TRUNCATE TABLE YOURTABLE RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;"
